verdict.rationale: Missive is a SaaS shared inbox, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its changelog says external AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor can connect to Missive through the Model Context Protocol and act on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts with permissions the user chooses. Other changelog entries and the pricing page refer to the 'MCP server' and 'API & MCP access', and a probe found official server docs at /docs/ai/mcp/server. The custom-MCP client evidence, where Missive's own assistant connects to outside servers, is a different role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: quoted setup and authentication details for the server mode, an enumerated tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration that external agents connect successfully.
